Bureau  of  Rehabilitation

33.
The  Minister  may  from  time  to  time  issue  to  the
Council  general  or  special  directions  as  to  the  exercise,
performance  and  discharge  of  the  powers,  duties  and
functions of the Council.

34.
(1) Subject to the provisions of this Act, the Council
may  make  rules  in  respect  of  all  or  any  of  the  following
matters:-

(a)
all matters for which rules are authorised or required
to be made under this Act;

(b)
the meetings of the Council and the procedure to
be followed at such meeting;

(c)
the  appointment,  promotion,  remuneration  and
disciplinary control of officers and employees and
the grant of leave and other emoluments to officers
and employees; and

(d)
any matter connected with the affairs of the Bureau.
(2) Every rule made by the Bureau shall be approved by
the  Minister  and  published  in  the  Gazette  and  shall  come
into operation on the date of its publication or on such later
date as may be specified therein.

35.

purpose of carrying out and giving effect to the principles
and provisions of this Act.
(2) In particular and without prejudice to the generality
of the powers conferred on subsection (1), the Minister may
make regulations for-
